identity_policy: slug is immutable stable semantic identity from v1.0.0 onward; slugs are never reused; database UUID is intentionally absent
assignment_policy: exactly one active assignable leaf category per canonical product

home_navigation_policy.all_categories: show every canonical L1; unavailable categories sort last with a non-dead explanatory state

publishing_policy.rule: a risky leaf cannot publish until category-specific policy, evidence requirements, moderation owner and audit path exist

versioning.PATCH: display name, merchant label, alias, keyword or copy change
versioning.MINOR: new node, parent move or backward-compatible deprecation with mapping
versioning.MAJOR: backward-incompatible L1 boundary or semantic identity change

governance.deprecate: never_hard_delete_identity; record effective version and replacement strategy
governance.backward_compatibility: old slug resolution and replacement mappings are permanent
governance.alias_management: versioned, owner-reviewed, brand-free and informed by measured search behavior
